map.爆炒（大火）适合绿叶菜、腰花等易熟食材，快速出锅保脆嫩保色；火力不足会出水变焖。: Stir-fry (high heat) suits tender greens, kidney, etc.—quick out of the wok keeps crispness and color; weak heat steams them watery.

map.炖、煨、卤（小火/微火）长时间加热使肉质酥烂、汤汁醇厚，大火易糊底，需先大火煮沸: Braise/stew/red-cook (low/simmer) long heating tenderizes meat and enriches broth; high heat scorches—boil first on high, then lower.

map.大火和中火怎么判断？: How to tell high from medium heat?
map.大火火焰窜出锅沿、蓝焰集中；中火火焰稳定在锅底、不外延；家用灶以火焰接触面与声音: High: flames leap past the wok rim, blue and concentrated; medium: flames stay at the base, not spreading; at home use flame contact and sizzle sound as cues.
map.为什么炖肉要先大火后小火？: Why boil then simmer for braised meat?
map.大火煮沸去浮沫、定味，小火慢炖让胶原脂肪转化、肉质酥烂且汤清不浑，久大火则易糊底: High heat boils off scum and sets flavor; low heat slowly converts collagen/fat for tender meat and clear broth; prolonged high heat scorches and toughens.
